annotations.title: Find fix-and-flip or DSCR lenders by state

description: Lists the hard-money and DSCR lenders on fixandflip.loans whose own websites (read 2026-10-24) say they lend in a state, with starting rate, leverage, minimum credit score, experience rule, loan size and a source link each. Lenders that publish no state list are returned as "check".

credit_score.description: Optional, fix_flip only: drop lenders whose published minimum FICO is above this score.

loan_type.description: fix_flip (default; hard-money rehab loans) or dscr_rental (rental loans sized on rent).

offset.description: Lenders to skip, for paging. Default 0.

sort.description: rate (default; lowest advertised starting rate first, unpublished last) or name.

state.description: Two-letter property state, e.g. TX. Omit for every lender.

name: find_lenders
title: Find fix-and-flip or DSCR lenders by state
